Inputs!E73.label: Interest pause end (accrual resumes on this date; user 09-Oct-26)
Inputs!E73.note: Every interest / return accrual (securities 6 % / 12 %, participation fee, devex and land 20 % with the 2× minimum, shareholder-loan and guarantee interest) pauses from row 64 to here, then runs on to the exit date (RtB sale E58; COD sale E155). Not paused: success fee (BORA_Devex X37 = V37), bank guarantee fees. Exact while the pause ends on 1 January (each year keeps one stub); a pause ending mid-year splits that year into two simple stubs – cross-term r²·a·b/365², ≈ +0.8 % on a 20 % line for half a year each side – so a zero-length pause is not exactly the continuous accrual.

Inputs!E234.note: BID OFFERING – FEP's intended commitment, not an estimate. Charged as an opex line on net generation in every operating year, not escalated (HTM row 59). Sits at the bottom of the scoring band (points start above 2 €/MWh), so it scores nothing – raising it towards 3 €/MWh buys points at roughly 15 m€ of lifetime cost per €/MWh.
